name: Octal Credit Capital Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1992, Octal Credit Capital Ltd is engaged in Loan Financing and Trading
in Shares and Securities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
OCCL is registered as a non-systematic 
important non-deposit accepting non-banking
 financial company, and classified as NBFC-Base Layer. The company is principally into lending and investing in Shares and Securities.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.43 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 5.92% over last 3 years.
